in_marathi.name: Paramita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Crossing the boundary, reaching the other side
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paramita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paramita represents the idea of crossing a boundary or threshold, reaching the other side, be it spiritual, emotional, or physical. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of various goddesses and deities who help devotees transcend their limitations and achieve their goals. The term is also used in Buddhism to describe the stages of enlightenment.
